article_boy_who_told_truth.summary: An always tells the truth, even when the truth is hard to say. Follow him through the day he breaks his mother's blue bowl. You will learn the three parts of the story, four new words, and what happened when he chose not to hide.
article_boy_who_told_truth.title: The Boy Who Always Told the Truth

article_culture_shock.summary: Moving to a new country changes small things before big ones: greetings, meals, punctuality, silence. After reading this you can name what is surprising you, tell a personal habit from a local rule, and handle the first weeks without assuming that your way is the correct one.
article_culture_shock.title: Culture Shock: Things That Surprise People Abroad

article_intelligence_nature.summary: Intelligence is not one number, and it is not the same as knowledge or skill. After reading this you can describe what intelligence is, explain why one mind is strong in one field and weak in another, separate the general factor from the specific profiles, and use six steps to write your own profile and put it to work in a team.
article_intelligence_nature.title: The Nature of Intelligence: Why One Mind Shines in One Field
